name: Jamie Emerson
title: Principal Engineer | Digital Platforms & Technical Strategy
intro: I build software for ambiguous, data-heavy problems where the first challenge is deciding what the system should be. Over 15+ years, I’ve led airline telemetry and operations analytics, built research software supporting peer-reviewed neuroscience, replatformed an aerospace web ecosystem, and co-founded an agency through acquisition. I set technical direction, make consequential architecture decisions, and stay hands-on through delivery.

experience.name: BETA Technologies
experience.description: Aerospace manufacturer developing electric aircraft, propulsion systems, and charging infrastructure.
bullets: Defined a web strategy that repositioned BETA's site from a brochure into an educational platform for an emerging industry, designed to improve organic and AI-assisted discovery while better representing the company's maturity and capabilities.
Own the platform architecture and roadmap, establishing the development lifecycle, environments, and operating model for a production-grade web platform.
Positioned the website as an integration point across the company's broader technology stack, expanding its value to sales, operations, and leadership.
Established a structured measurement strategy that gives marketing and leadership visibility into user behavior, engagement, and conversion.

experience.name: Bilte Co
experience.description: Independent software consultancy providing architecture, product development, and fractional technical leadership to startups, research groups, and enterprise teams.
bullets: Lead architecture and hands-on delivery for digital platforms, internal tools, and enterprise integrations for clients including Southwest Airlines, Yale University, and NetApp.
Translate ambiguous commercial or research goals into scoped delivery plans, technical roadmaps, and production software under constrained timelines and budgets.
Assemble, mentor, and lead senior teams for multidisciplinary engagements, owning delivery quality from discovery through launch.

experience.name: Emerson Stone
experience.description: Emerson Stone was a strategy-led digital product and brand agency serving Fortune 500 and growth-stage clients including IBM, 3M, Section.io, and Audi. Acquired in 2019.
bullets: Co-founded and grew the agency from zero, hiring and leading engineers, designers, and operations staff while maintaining high delivery standards and a durable team culture.
Owned technical strategy from pre-sales through delivery: discovery, estimation, architecture, integrations, migrations, audits, and handoff.
Built trusted executive and technical relationships that supported deeper engagements and sustained strong year-over-year revenue growth throughout the agency's six years.
Served as senior technical lead across frontend, backend, CMS, ecommerce, and enterprise marketing work, pairing hands-on implementation with team mentorship.
